name: Android emulator (stable)
command: D=~/.local/share/open-teams-android; export ANDROID_HOME=$D/sdk ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$D/sdk; $D/sdk/emulator/emulator -avd ot35 -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -gpu swiftshader_indirect -feature -Vulkan -no-snapshot-save -memory 4096 -cores 4 > /tmp/emulator.log 2>&1; echo "emulator exit $?"
